items.subject: the Colonial mine tailings dump at the mouth of Wittenoom Gorge, its blue asbestos tailings sliding into a runoff channel
items.action: rainwater sheets off the dump and carries the blue tailings downslope into a red-earth creek
items.gaze_interaction: focal line follows the muddy runoff from the dump down toward the distant creek bed
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge, Pilbara, the abandoned Colonial mine dump below banded red ironstone cliffs, after a rain
items.color_palette: red earth, rusted ochre cliffs, grey-blue tailings, wet brown runoff, pale washed sky
items.props_detail: a fresh erosion gully cut through the dump face, glistening with water
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: pale overcast dawn after rain, soft diffuse light
items.mood: still damp air, slow silent trickle of water, a vast scar under a low grey sky
items.narration_anchor: Los relaves del vertedero de Colonial se van con el agua.

items.subject: a few distant environmental survey observers, Anglo-Australian adults in faded field shirts and wide hats, seen from behind
items.action: they stand at the toe of the tailings dump, marking the point where the runoff channel begins
items.gaze_interaction: figures face away from camera, looking down the erosion channel toward the gorge exit
items.setting: base of the Colonial tailings dump, Wittenoom Gorge, red rock walls and spinifex, 2021
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, dusty grey, faint blue streaks, muted khaki
items.props_detail: a rusted star picket survey marker driven into the wet blue-grey silt
items.lighting: pale overcast dawn, soft diffuse light
items.mood: small figures dwarfed by the dump and cliffs, motionless air, damp ground
items.narration_anchor: Un informe técnico lo marcó como la fuente principal y la vía del asbesto:

items.subject: a braided creek system winding out of the gorge across a floodplain toward the Fortescue River
items.action: shallow water threads through creek beds and pools, spreading across the floodplain toward the distant river line
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs from the gorge mouth outward to the horizon river
items.setting: Pilbara floodplain below Wittenoom Gorge, river gums along the channels, Fortescue River on the horizon
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre banks, olive gum trees, silver pools, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: a chain of still pools catching the sky along the creek bed
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: pale overcast dawn, soft diffuse light
items.mood: vast silent land, water barely moving, mist lifting off the pools
items.narration_anchor: la erosión, los lechos de arroyo, las pozas, las llanuras de inundación hacia el río Fortescue.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings left as a drying rind at the edge of a shrinking creek pool
items.action: the pool evaporates and leaves a fine blue tideline on cracked red mud
items.gaze_interaction: focal point on the blue tideline where wet meets dry
items.setting: a drying creek bed pool downstream of Wittenoom, cracked mud and river stones
items.color_palette: cracked red-brown mud, faint blue fibrous rind, silver water, ochre stones
items.props_detail: a single dry river-gum leaf resting on the blue-dusted mud crust
items.lens_technique: shallow depth of field, macro lens
items.lighting: pale overcast dawn, soft diffuse light
items.mood: utter stillness, shallow water receding, quiet dry crust
items.narration_anchor: Fibras azules que el agua deja donde se seca.

items.subject: a creek channel well outside the marked contamination zone, a weathered boundary sign post standing far behind upstream
items.action: water flows past the old zone boundary and on into open country, carrying faint blue sediment
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction looks downstream away from the distant boundary post
items.setting: open Pilbara creek channel beyond the Wittenoom contamination boundary, spinifex and river gums, 2021
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, olive gum foliage, faint blue streaks in grey sand, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a small grey-blue sediment bar on the inside bend of the creek
items.lighting: pale overcast dawn, soft diffuse light
items.mood: quiet open country, slow water, the boundary small and powerless behind
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintiuno, una nota ambiental registró fibras en canales de arroyos fuera de la zona marcada como contaminada.

items.subject: the broad Fortescue River catchment stretching to the horizon
items.action: a wide river pool lies still while faint sediment plumes drift in from a side creek
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction toward the endless horizon of the catchment
items.setting: Fortescue River valley, Pilbara, river gums and red ranges, no human presence
items.color_palette: deep red ranges, ochre plain, olive gums, steel-grey water, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: a pale sediment plume curling into the dark river water
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.lighting: pale overcast dawn turning to soft first light
items.mood: immense silent valley, time stretched out, water carrying on unattended
items.narration_anchor: El mismo informe advirtió que, sin intervención, el aporte de asbesto a la cuenca del Fortescue puede seguir durante cientos de años.

items.subject: an elderly Aboriginal Banjima man around 70, thin frame and hollowed cheeks from illness, seated on a camp chair beside a Latin American man in his fifties in a plain shirt
items.action: the two men sit side by side on Banjima country, the elder speaking and gesturing toward the gorge
items.gaze_interaction: elder looks out toward the red cliffs, the visitor turned toward him listening, notebook resting on his knee
items.setting: red earth clearing near Wittenoom Gorge, spinifex and a river gum, 2023
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre cliffs, faded khaki and white shirts, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a battered tin mug of tea set on the red ground between the chairs
items.mood: long warm light, unhurried stillness, the elder's shoulders bowed and breath shallow
items.narration_anchor: Es tierra Banjima. En dos mil veintitrés, Marcos Orellana visitó Australia y se sentó con Maitland Parker, un anciano Banjima.

items.subject: the elderly Aboriginal Banjima man around 70, gaunt and frail from illness, in a sun-faded work shirt
items.action: he stands at the edge of a creek bed, one hand resting on a walking stick, refusing to turn away from his country
items.gaze_interaction: face toward the camera at a distance, eyes lowered to the land, wet lines on weathered cheeks
items.setting: a dry creek bed below Wittenoom Gorge, red cliffs behind, river gums, 2023
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, faded blue shirt, grey-blue silt, golden light
items.props_detail: a worn wooden walking stick planted in the blue-grey creek silt
items.lighting: low golden late-afternoon sun, long shadows
items.mood: sagging shoulders against warm light, wind lifting dust around his feet, quiet rootedness
items.narration_anchor: «Todavía lloro por mi territorio, pero eso está arraigado en mí; simplemente no puedo alejarme de él», dijo Parker.

items.subject: an empty camp chair and a worn walking stick left beside a creek bed on Banjima country
items.action: the chair stands empty facing the gorge as wind moves dust across the red ground
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction from the empty chair out toward the cliffs he watched
items.setting: red earth bank above a dry creek near Wittenoom Gorge, 2024
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre cliffs, faded canvas, golden dust
items.props_detail: the walking stick leaning against the empty chair
items.lighting: low golden sunset, long shadow of the chair
items.mood: absence held in warm fading light, dust drifting, total silence
items.narration_anchor: Maitland Parker murió de mesotelioma en dos mil veinticuatro.

items.subject: a few Aboriginal Banjima representatives, adults of mixed ages in plain dark shirts, seen from behind
items.action: they climb the wide steps of a Federal Court building carrying a document box
items.gaze_interaction: figures turned away toward the court entrance, one older woman pausing to look up at the facade
items.setting: exterior of a Federal Court building in Perth, Western Australia, 2026
items.color_palette: pale sandstone, grey concrete, dark clothing, hard blue sky
items.props_detail: a cardboard archive box of legal papers carried in front of the group
items.lighting: clear early morning light, crisp shadows
items.mood: small figures against a massive facade, steady upward steps, cool morning air
items.narration_anchor: Dos años después, Gordon Legal presentó en nombre de BNTAC un proceso contra Australia Occidental en el Tribunal Federal.

items.subject: a permanent steel barricade across the old road into Wittenoom Gorge
items.action: wind blows red dust across the closed road beyond the barrier; nothing moves on the other side
items.gaze_interaction: focal line runs down the empty road past the barrier into red emptiness
items.setting: entrance road to the former Wittenoom townsite and gorge, cracked bitumen, spinifex, distant red ranges
items.color_palette: rusted steel, faded warning red and white, red earth, ochre, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a sun-bleached warning sign bolted to the barricade
items.lighting: pale dawn light, low sun on the horizon
items.mood: wind and drifting dust, an untouched road, open suspended silence

text_in_image.location: on the warning sign fixed to the barricade

items.narration_anchor: Nadie ha empezado a limpiar. En los accesos al pueblo y desfiladero hay bloqueos.

items.subject: the abandoned Wittenoom townsite seen from above, a few remaining Wittenoom buildings scattered across the red plain
items.action: dawn wind pushes dust across empty streets and vacant lots where houses once stood
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction over the whole deserted town toward the gorge mouth
items.setting: former Wittenoom townsite, Pilbara, ruled streets, airstrip scar and gorge beyond
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, weathered grey iron, faint blue tailings patches, pale dawn sky
items.props_detail: a lone dust devil crossing an empty street
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide lens
items.mood: vast emptiness, slow wind, a held silent note
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de un «grave problema de salud y seguri
